name: When should I consider a custom home renovation instead of buying a new home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a custom home renovation instead of buying a new home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom home renovation is ideal when you love your current location or neighborhood but your existing home no longer meets your needs. It allows you to tailor the living space exactly to your preferences without the hassle of moving. Renovating can also be more cost-effective than purchasing a new home, especially if current market prices are high, or if you wish to preserve the character and history of your existing property while upgrading its functionality and aesthetics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider renovation when you love your location but need a home tailored to your exact needs, or if it's more cost-effective than moving.
